title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
**IMPORTANT: Applications are accepted ONLY via our official website.**

**Apply here https://www.technource.com/jobs/senior\-team\-lead\-full\-stack\-developer/**

Technource is looking for a **Senior / Team Lead Full\-Stack Developer** with strong hands\-on experience across both backend and frontend development. The candidate should currently be working with modern JavaScript technologies such as **Node.js, NestJS, ReactJS, or Next.js** and should be capable of independently handling complete web application development. Candidates with a Laravel background are also welcome, provided they have been actively working in **JavaScript full\-stack development for at least the last 1\+ year**.

**Key Responsibilities, Skills \& Experience Required:**

* Strong hands\-on **full\-stack development experience**, with practical expertise in both backend and frontend development using technologies such as **Node.js / NestJS and ReactJS / Next.js**, along with strong working knowledge of **TypeScript**.
* Candidates coming from a **Laravel background** can also be considered, provided they have transitioned into JavaScript full\-stack development and have at least **1\+ year of recent hands\-on experience** with Node.js and React/Next\-based technologies.
* Must have experience building **complete web applications**, including frontend interfaces, backend APIs, database integration, authentication, third\-party integrations, and production\-ready functionality.
* Strong understanding of **clean coding, reusable architecture, code reviews, performance optimization, and scalable application development**. Experience in solution or architecture\-level decision\-making will be an added advantage.
* Practical awareness of **DevOps workflows**, including deployments, CI/CD, environments, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure, is good to have.
* Experience using **AI\-assisted coding tools / AI agents** for development, code review, debugging, or productivity improvement is preferred. Exposure to **AI API integrations, workflow automation, and agent\-based solutions** will be an added advantage.
* Excellent **English communication and presentation skills**, with the ability to explain technical solutions clearly, participate in client discussions, and guide other developers when required.

**How to Apply:**

* **Please apply only through our website: https://www.technource.com/jobs/senior\-team\-lead\-full\-stack\-developer/**
* **Applications submitted via Indeed will not be reviewed..**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**IMPORTANT: Applications are accepted ONLY via our official website**

**Apply here: https://www.technource.com/jobs/junior\-project\-coordinator/**

Technource is looking for a **Junior Project Coordinator** who is interested in building a career in software project coordination and delivery. The role involves working closely with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to support smooth project execution, task tracking, requirement coordination, and timely communication. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with good communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills who wants to grow into project management within an IT services environment.

**Key Responsibilities \& Requirements:**

* Basic understanding of the **software development lifecycle, web/mobile application projects, and Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Assist Project Managers and senior team members with **task tracking, team follow\-ups, requirement coordination, project updates, and ensuring activities move as planned**.
* Coordinate with **Developers, QA, Business Analysts, Designers, and other project team members** to track dependencies, pending discussions, and project progress.
* Ability to understand basic client/business requirements and help maintain proper **project documentation, task updates, meeting notes, and follow\-up records**.
* Familiarity with project management and communication tools such as **Jira, Trello, Slack, or similar platforms** is an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of technology stacks such as **Laravel, Node.js, React.js, mobile technologies, or other software development technologies** will be preferred.
* Good **English communication and presentation skills**, attention to detail, strong follow\-up ability, and willingness to learn client communication and project management under guidance.

**How to Apply:**

* **Please apply only through our website: https://www.technource.com/jobs/junior\-project\-coordinator/**
* **Applications submitted via Indeed will not be reviewed.**

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹120,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**About Us**

Maharshi Industries Pvt Ltd (MIPL) is a leader in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, and Virtual Reality Simulation systems, serving Defence, Police, Railways, Oil \& Gas, and Industrial sectors under the *Make in India* initiative. We are seeking a skilled **Full Stack Developer** to design and build advanced **Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs)** for our cutting\-edge **VR and AI\-driven products and platforms**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop **responsive, intuitive GUIs** for VR and AI\-based applications.
* Collaborate with **VR developers, AI engineers, and robotics teams** to integrate backend logic with interactive frontends.
* Build **cross\-platform dashboards** for real\-time data visualization, control, and monitoring of AI/VR systems.
* Develop APIs and middleware to ensure smooth communication between **AI modules, VR simulations, and hardware devices**.
* Optimize applications for **performance, scalability, and security**.
* Participate in **code reviews, testing, and debugging** to maintain high\-quality deliverables.
* Document technical workflows and provide support for integration and deployment.

**Required Skills \& Technologies**

**Frontend Development**

* Strong in **JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3**.
* Experience with modern frameworks: **React.js / Angular / Vue.js**.
* UI/UX design knowledge to build user\-friendly dashboards.

**Backend Development**

* Proficiency in **Node.js, Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), or Java**.
* Database experience: **MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB**.
* RESTful APIs and WebSocket integration.

**Integration \& Tools**

* Experience with **3D/VR libraries (Three.js, Babylon.js, Unity WebGL integration preferred)**.
* Familiarity with **AI/ML integration workflows** (Python APIs, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or ONNX runtime).
* Knowledge of **Git/GitHub, Docker, CI/CD pipelines**.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical ability.
* Ability to **collaborate with cross\-functional teams** (VR engineers, AI scientists, robotics experts).
* Strong communication skills and ownership of deliverables.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field**.
* Minimum 1–3 years of experience as a **Full Stack Developer.**
* Prior work experience with full stack development is a mandatory.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* 1\. Have you worked on any live projects ?
* 2\. Have you worked on real time protocols?
* 3\. Have you done any integration with external API's ?
* 4\. What is your current on\-hand salary in Lacs per annum?
* 5\. What is your expected on\-hand salary in Lacs per annum?
* 6\. What is your notice period?

Work Location: In person
